nodes.description: Nonsense, frameshift, splice-site, multi-exon deletion and some missense alleles abolish or sharply reduce CFAP43. Patient sperm show low CFAP43 mRNA and absent or reduced CFAP43 protein in the flagellum, and splice alleles cause exon skipping. CFAP43 is one half of the tether/tether-head (T/TH) complex, which in ciliates links the I1 inner dynein arm motor domains to the A-tubule of the doublet microtubule; loss of this binding function is inferred from the orthologous complex.
